SessionStep helper: scoped attempt execution
|
|-- Captured references -> Bus / LLMClient / Snapshot / ToolOutput
`-- attempt(input): owns transient streaming/tool work, not durable history
    |-- Pending start-snapshot fiber -> Snapshot.capture
    |-- Attempt-local event publisher (createLLMEventPublisher)
    |   |-- Step flags/record: started, output, failure, finish, continuation
    |   |-- Tool-state map: called, settled, provider-executed, progress
    |   |-- Text/reasoning fragments: ordinals, buffers, delta timers
    |   `-- -> Bus.publish: text/reasoning/tool/usage/step projections
    |-- toolRuns[]: local call + scoped fiber + cooperative cancel handle
    |-- Provider stream consumer -> LLMClient.stream(request, options)
    |   |-- Join start snapshot before first event; publish through stream end
    |   |-- Local Tool.Called commit precedes tool-fiber creation
    |   |   `-- Owned tool fiber
    |   |       |-- -> prepared.executeTool -> selected Tool snapshot.execute
    |   |       |   `-- Registry hooks / permissions; tools disabled at step limit
    |   |       `-- -> ToolOutput.truncate -> publisher.toolExecution
    |   `-- Provider-executed tools are published, not forked locally
    `-- Settlement (final durable publications are uninterruptible)
        |-- Mark streamed; join owned tool fibers before final step events
        |-- User stop -> cooperative tool cancel; interrupt remaining fibers
        |-- Declines / cancelled questions -> control failure, not tool output
        |   `-- Closed location can return continuation for graph handoff
        |-- Process-daemon handoff interruption -> leave calls/step unsettled
        |   `-- Next runner invocation settles stale work after restart
        |-- Before visible output -> overflow/full-request recovery or retry
        |-- Settle failures, missing hosted results and incomplete tool inputs
        |-- End snapshot + file changes + usage -> Step.Ended or step failure
        `-- Return Completed / Retry / RecoverFull / Compacted / OutputLimit
